Definition: a string (as twisted), i.e. (specifically) the umbilical cord (also figuratively, as the centre of strength)
BiblicalUsage: Shor is the navel, the cord and the centre of the body, and it appears where life begins and where health is promised. Jerusalem at her birth had her navel uncut, and the proverb says the fear of the Lord shall be health to the navel and marrow to the bones.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God tends the beginnings of things, and a navel uncut is a child unloved, yet the Lord's care reaches the very centre of the body He made.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
